item.title: Claude Daily Digest — Tue, Sep 15
item.description: Claude Code v2.1.273 lands with bash permission fix and session forking; compaction-on-demand API beta; tip: Claude Code reads your git history by default.
item.content:encoded:
What's New

Claude Code v2.1.273 released Sep 15. Key changes:

  • Gateway hint headers — Claude Code sends metadata headers to help MCP servers understand the calling context
  • MDM settings fix — MDM-managed config was being ignored on first launch; now resolved
  • Bash permission bypass fix — closes a path where bash tool calls could skip permission checks in certain auto-mode scenarios
  • Session forking from Remote Control — fork a running session into a new branch from the Remote Control interface

Docs Changes

Sep 14: Messages API compaction on demand (beta) — trigger conversation compaction manually and receive a signed compaction block summarizing prior messages. Enable with the compact-2026-09-04 beta header. Useful for long-running agentic sessions.

Tip #17 — Git-Aware by Default

Claude Code reads your git history, branch diffs, and blame automatically. Ask it “what changed in the last 3 commits that could explain this bug?” and it digs through the log — no extra setup needed. Especially useful when debugging a regression where you know roughly when it appeared but not why.

Have You Seen? Official Claude System Prompts

Anthropic published their own system prompts publicly in August 2026. The Claude Code tool definitions, how Opus 5 evolved, and internal behaviors are now documented. Simon Willison maintains a git-tracking repo that follows prompt changes over time — a great resource for anyone building Claude Code training material or writing their own system prompts.

item.title: Claude Daily Digest — Mon, Sep 14
item.description: v2.1.271 brings fast mode to Remote sessions and per-command network sandboxing; v2.1.272 fixes land same day; --model flag tip for tier matching.
item.content:encoded:
Claude Daily Digest — Mon, Sep 14

What's New

Two Claude Code releases landed today:

v2.1.271:

  • Fast mode in Remote sessions — /fast now works in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions.
  • Per-command allowed_domains — Bash/PowerShell commands in auto mode can declare exactly which network hosts they need.
  • omitClaudeMd for subagents — Plugin subagents can run without loading user/project CLAUDE.md files.

v2.1.272 — Bug fixes and reliability improvements.

Docs Changes

Sep 10 — Claude Managed Agents updates:

  • Auto permission evaluation — Managed Agents now support an auto mode.
  • Terminal session attachment — ant beta:sessions connect lets you attach your terminal to a live Managed Agents session.

Tip of the Day #16

Match the model to the task: --model haiku for fast iteration; --model sonnet for the daily workhorse; --model opus for the hard stuff.

Have You Seen? — Claude Code auto mode

Fully autonomous agentic execution — toggle with /auto.
